CONNECT

Who knows SSET programs and courses best?

Form your teams: Each team will draw one RMIT programme that your team is responsible for.

Relay challenge: One by one, team members take turns running to the card station and choosing one card that they think matches their programme.

Time limit: Within the given time, the team with the most correct cards wins!

One card at a time: Each player may take only ONE card per turn.

Wrong card? If you realise you picked the wrong card, you must return it to the card station first. You can only pick a new card on your next turn.

Activity: BUILD YOUR PORTFOLIO WEBSITE

TEAM ROLES
STEP 1
STEP 2
STEP 3
YOUR MISSION

👥 TEAM ROLES (2 roles per team)

  • BA (Business Analyst): Listens to client needs, writes clear requirements, describes designs to DEV, and clarifies all questions.
  • DEV (Developer): Draws the UI/UX design on paper. No coding!
  • PM (Host): I'll guide the process, manage the clock, and give the final go-ahead.

STEP 1: PM → BA (VERBAL BRIEF) → BA → DEV (VERBAL DESCRIPTION)

(PM to BA, then BA describes to DEV – NO drawing by BA!)

  • PM (me) tells BA exactly what the client wants for the Portfolio Website.
  • BA turns this into clear, structured requirements and verbally describes the UI layout, pages, and flow to DEV.
  • DEV listens carefully and starts sketching the first rough paper draft based purely on BA's words (no visual aids from BA).

STEP 2: CLARIFY & FINALIZE THE PAPER DESIGN (DEV ↔ BA)

  • DEV reviews the rough sketch and asks technical/design clarification questions.
  • BA answers everything, clears up ambiguities, and refines the verbal description.
  • DEV finalizes the complete, clean UI/UX design on paper (detailed wireframes with connected pages).

STEP 3: PRESENT TO PM (ME) (BA + DEV → PM)

  • BA & DEV pitch their final paper prototype to PM (me) – walking through the pages, user flow, and design rationale.
  • PM gives feedback and final sign-off.

🎯 YOUR MISSION: In a team (BA + DEV), complete Steps 1 → 2 → 3. Deliver a polished, paper-based UI/UX prototype for a Portfolio Website and pitch it to me!
